claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_size
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's headline mechanic is a temporary self size increase to Large. The current surface has speed, senses, AC, conditions, and full polymorph-style transformation, but no bounded size-change atom for a creature that remains itself.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.abilityCheckAbilityFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait grants advantage on all Strength checks, not only named skills and not only checks to end a condition. Existing narrowing supports skillFilter and conditionFilter, plus saveAbilityFilter for saves, but no ability-axis filter for generic ability checks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.manualEnd = no_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The timed self-buff can end early at the user's discretion without spending an action. Current timed durations only support specific early-end triggers, not voluntary dismissal for non-summon effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required)
